title: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma says the unit will divest five studios, including Ninja Theory, alongside ~3,200 job cuts, to streamline the business, in a "reset" (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma says the unit will divest five studios, including Ninja Theory, alongside ~3,200 job cuts, to streamline the business, in a “reset” — Compulsion and Double Fine studios will become independent; Undead Labs and Ninja Theory will be sold.
